briefTitle: The Evaluation of PC14586 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors Harboring a TP53 Y220C Mutation (PYNNACLE)

typedChecks.sourceText: At least 18 years of age or 12 to 17 years of age after Safety Review Committee approval.
typedChecks.stringValue: At least 18 years of age or 12 to 17 years of age after Safety Review Committee approval.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: At least 18 years of age or 12 to 17 years of age after Safety Review Committee approval.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: 12 to 17 years of age after Safety Review Committee approval
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Age minimum has conditional allowance for 12 to 17 years requiring committee approval, which cannot be captured in a simple numeric age_min check alone.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Locally advanced or metastatic solid malignancy with a TP53 Y220C mutation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: TP53 mutation is not among the allowed typed gene mutation kinds (which are limited to egfr, alk, kras, ros1, braf).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 (Phase 2)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Anti-cancer therapy within 21 days (or 5 half-lives) of receiving the study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window based on half-lives is complex and not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Radiotherapy within 14 days of receiving the study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiotherapy washout window is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Primary CNS tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Primary CNS tumor exclusion is not covered by typed brain_mets kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of leptomeningeal disease or spinal cord compression
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Leptomeningeal disease and spinal cord compression are specific CNS exclusions not captured by brain_mets.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Stroke or transient ischemic attack within 6 months prior to screening
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiovascular and cerebrovascular timing exclusions are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Heart conditions such as unstable angina within 6 months prior to screening, uncontrolled hypertension, a heart attack within 6 months prior to screening, congestive heart failure, prolongation of QT interval, or other rhythm abnormalities
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cardiac condition exclusions are clinical judgment items.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Strong CYP3A4 inducers and strong CYP2C9 inhibitors/inducers within 14 days of first dose of rezatapopt
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medication restrictions are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of gastrointestinal (GI) disease that may interfere with absorption of study drug or patients unable to take oral medication
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: GI absorption interference and ability to swallow oral medications are subjective items.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of prior organ transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ transplant history is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known, active malignancy, except for treated cervical intraepithelial neoplasia, or non-melanoma skin cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active secondary malignancy exclusion with exceptions is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known, active uncontrolled Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, or human immunodeficiency virus infection
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Infectious disease criteria are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known KRAS mutation, defined as a single nucleotide variant (SNV) (Phase 2). Exception: Ovarian cancer patients with a known KRAS SNV are permitted.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: KRAS variant exclusion with a cancer-specific exception cannot be expressed with a simple typed kras_status check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Vaccine washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Diagnosis of immunodeficiency or receiving chronic systemic steroid therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study drug
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Chronic steroid therapy and immunodeficiency are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Hypersensitivity (≥ Grade 3) to pembrolizumab and/or any of its excipients
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hypersensitivity exclusion is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in past 2 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disease history is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of radiation pneumonitis
